prompt: Create a highly detailed cinematic fantasy solarpunk harbor city at sunset, wide panoramic 16:9 composition, magical realism, warm golden-hour lighting after rain, wet cobblestone foreground reflecting neon and lantern glow. Include exactly 5 colorful flying fish or birdlike gliders near the rainbows. In the center distance, a gigantic floating whale-island covered with grass and tiny trees carries exactly 2 standing human figures on its back. Mood: hopeful, whimsical, utopian, richly textured, awe-inspiring but peaceful. Style: ultra-detailed digital painting, painterly realism with storybook fantasy, volumetric sunset rays, mist from waterfalls, crisp foreground details, deep atmospheric perspective, no modern cars, no harsh sci-fi weapons, no blank areas.
